title: Uncontrolled Heartbeat Thread Blocking
pattern: Conducting synchronous, network-blocking database queries or API pings directly inside the heartbeat/health-check reporting thread.
why_bad: If the backend hangs, the heartbeat thread blocks on the ping call. The orchestrator/load balancer receives no health-checks and falsely assumes the node is dead, terminating the healthy container and initiating a cascading cluster teardown.
detection: Synchronous block/read network calls executed directly on a thread responsible for writing/answering health checks or heartbeats.
counterexample: Asynchronous heartbeats with independent, short non-blocking timeouts.
fix: Execute pings asynchronously with short timeouts, or use a non-blocking background worker to update a shared atomic "last success timestamp" that the heartbeat thread reads without blocking.
